row:
Welcome to Almost Home Cat Rescue MKE—a 100% volunteer-run, cage-free cat rescue in Milwaukee dedicated to helping cats find safety, healing, and forever homes.

Here, you’ll get an inside look at what rescue life is REALLY like! 

🐱 Adorable cat & kitten videos
🎥 Behind-the-scenes rescue moments
🏠 Foster life and daily rescue operations
😺 Cat personalities, funny moments & transformations
💙 Rescue stories and adoption journeys
📚 Cat behavior, care, health & education
🤝 Community outreach and pet support

From tiny kittens to cats who have been waiting for their second chance, our channel shares the highs, challenges, surprises, and unforgettable moments that happen behind the scenes of cat rescue.

Subscribe, watch, like, comment, and share to help more people discover rescue cats—and help us get more cats one step closer to HOME.
